cluster analysis code

R Code > rt2<-read.table("sj2.txt",head=T) > X<-scale(rt2,center=T,scale=T) > D2<-dist(X) > hc2<-hclust(D2,"ward") > plot(hc2,hang=-1,main="ward method") > rect.hclust(hc2,k=4)
